title: LLV-GFL300: cubic classical space with a quarter sqrt time correction and decaying remainder

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the single LLV-GFL300 configuration in proof.md recovers the full secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n)log2(n)+(1/4)sqrt(n)+2sqrt(n)(log2(n))^(-1/2))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. At n>=2^4096 compute v=floor(sqrt n),r=ceil(sqrt n),ell=ceil(log2n),lambda=ell,P=ell^2,H_n=bit_length(n^P-1),m=floor(P*(v-256ell)/(H_n+ell)),kappa=ceil(log2(m+2))+3,A_bar=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*lambda))+2,center=ceil((m-1)/2),fan_i=A_bar+i-center. Exact quadratic prefix capacity selects full levels and one final widthR,arity k=ceil((R+kappa+1)/lambda),one-qubit-output call. Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. Section14 deterministically charges per-level attempts to disjoint delivered leaves and proves log2T<=sqrt(n)log2(n)/2+sqrt(n)/4+O(sqrt(n)/log2(n))+O((log n)^2), which fits the exact three-term supported envelope and absorbs every polynomial overhead. All source/LE, lookup/exclusion, generation, arithmetic, failures, measurements and cleanup are charged jointly with the other claims.

For this same LLV-GFL300 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical space is O(n^3) bits with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index0. With lambda=ceil(log2n),2^lambda=O(n); O(n) retained full-label tables each contain O(n^2) bits. The single current tuple list uses O(n^2); current input/sort/residue arrays use O(n^(5/2)). The complete source/LE, cap arithmetic, stack, streamed decoder and generation ledger uses O(n^2). No full tree, truth table or exponential circuit is stored. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same LLV-GFL300 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Pending vector siblings use O(lambda*sum_i fan_i)=O(n); the finish and current fresh search use O(fan_max*lambda)=O(sqrt(n)log n)<=O(n) scratch, reset/reused between trials. Source/LE, rank/projection, failures and abort cleanup are included. The exact centered sum gives m*A_bar*lambda<=n+m*kappa+3m*lambda. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and the other claims.

For this same LLV-GFL300 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired copies number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Every rejected, failed, discarded and aborted acquisition counts. Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. The centered sum is at most m*A_bar, so AM-GM bounds its product by A_bar^m and every prefix/final arity through fan_max*A_bar^m. With P=ell^2,H_n=bit_length(n^P-1), Section8 proves A_bar<=sqrt(n)*(1+2/ell^2), log2A_bar<=log2(n)/2+3/ell^2<=(H_n+6)/(2P)<=D/2 and mD<=v-256ell. This covers all polynomial cap factors, yielding literal nCcap+K<=2^(v/2). The finite branch changes outside constants. All claims hold jointly with unconditional full-secret success.

For the same LLV-GFL300 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
